reasons: Admitted on the vendor's own fetched documentation; this application has not run a live key gate against this endpoint.
China-region platform: keys are issued by and bound to the China account system and are not interchangeable with the international platform's keys.
The vendor's OpenAI-dialect reasoning replay contract must not be assumed for Anthropic Messages without a dialect-specific document or probe.
The Anthropic root string was read by the research pass but not re-exposed on a later fetch; it follows the documented OpenAI host migration.

continuationDomain.sourceRef: BOTH halves. Own-state acceptance: https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/text-anthropic-api (read 2026-10-29): a request `thinking` block is "Echoed assistant thinking from a previous turn", its `signature` "Signature for echoed thinking content. Return unchanged in later turns."; "Append the full `response.content` list to the message history (includes all content blocks: thinking/text/tool_use)." Accepted input for M3.1-Flash and M3 only: "`MiniMax-M3.1-Flash` and `MiniMax-M3` support text, image, video, tool use, tool result, and thinking blocks. The M2.7, M2.5, M2.1, and M2 series support text and tool-call content blocks only." Why the domain is NARROW: the state is valid only for the model that produced it on this route -- a different model, or the same model at another provider (a different credential and account), never receives it, and the history renderer strips it there.
